name: stonedoorway-lab-session
role: Lab door — faculty + matrika + Laya + Pāṇini mini-task (not entity summoning)

relevance.castle: Faculty engine + method of places (optional purification)

voice_script.onboarding: You are now entering the Stone Doorway. Tonight is a Sanskrit lab session.
voice_script.intention: Choose one faculty: memory, intellect, eloquence, or understanding.
voice_script.threshold: Settle the breath. Quiet the body. We are not summoning entities — we are building an inhabitable inner world.
voice_script.install: Listen to the phoneme series. Place each letter in a definite locus. Give it colour and feeling.
voice_script.contractio: Hold one letter until sound, form, place and emotion fuse into a single image.
voice_script.laya: Drop the voice. Silence three minutes. Bindu on one phoneme.
voice_script.panini: Open the grammar machine for one rule or one pratyāhāra.
voice_script.return: Speak one Sanskrit word using the stack. Bring yourself back. Log what stuck.

safety.identity: lab door / guided practice — not Goetic conjuration

endgame_roadmap: voice: leave me here for one hour
